name: Umbral-Stele
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a subterranean ocean.
Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in dark crystals here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
